chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurara ibn A'yan, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the pregnant slave girl whom a man buys, so he attains from her besides the private part. He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no problem.' I said, 'Supposing he attains from her in that?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Do you intend deception?'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on having sexual intercourse with a pregnant slave girl before vaginal penetration?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies the permissibility of sexual intercourse with a pregnant slave girl, specifically addressing the act of *dawn al-farj* (penetration without full entry). The Imam’s follow-up question, 'Do you mean *taghrah* (deception/defrauding)?', highlights the juristic concern that such an act might be viewed as a defect in the transaction or a form of deception regarding the slave's fertility or status, yet it is deemed valid and not inherently deceptive.
